newsitem.title: USA: New Plan Realty sold $75 mln pref shares.
newsitem.headline: New Plan Realty sold $75 mln pref shares.

text.p: New Plan Realty Trust said Monday it sold depository shares representing $75 million of cumulative step-up rate preferred shares.
The real estate investment trust said it will use the proceeds to fund acquisitions.

The trust said the 1.5 million shares it sold have a face value of $50 a share and a dividend yielding 7.8 percent annually until September 15 2012 and 9.8 percent after that. The shares are non-callable for 10 years, it added.
A company spokesman said the preferred shares are now traded over-the-counter but will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange. He added Merrill Lynch & Co handled the sale.

The trust said June 26 it bought four properties for $45 million, bringing its year-to-date acquisitions to 25 with a total value of $234 million. The trust's stock traded unchanged at 22-3/16 Monday morning.
